faqs.question: Does 🦄🌟 mean what I think?
faqs.answer: Yes — 🦄🌟 rarely misreads. The two emojis together make the cue explicit enough that confusion is unusual.

faqs.question: What does 🦄🌟 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram 🦄🌟 punctuates reactions under photo drops and reel comments. The reaction register is the same as on iMessage.

faqs.question: What does 🦄🌟 mean from an ex?
faqs.answer: From an ex 🦄🌟 can read either as reaction to a public post or as a re-open coded signal. The combo is ambiguous in a 1:1 thread.

faqs.question: What does 🦄🌟 mean at the end of a sentence?
faqs.answer: Sandwiching 🦄🌟 at the end of a sentence amplifies the sentence. The combo reads as "yes, and I really mean it" without writing it out.
